description: Repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): POST /api/links/bulk-delete must validate the whole slug batch before deleting any link - not partially delete as it goes
prompts: Add a bulk delete endpoint: `POST /api/links/bulk-delete`, accepting `{"slugs": [...]}` and returning `{"deleted": [...]}`. It must be all-or-nothing: validate that EVERY slug in the request refers to an existing link BEFORE deleting any of them. If any slug is missing, respond 404 and leave every link completely untouched - not partially deleted up to the point where the missing slug was hit. Reject a non-array or non-string-array `slugs` with 400.
name: add_shortlink_bulk_delete_atomic
